name: Helen Brown
story: Helen Brown was credited with Takerei Norton as a creative director of Kā Huru Manu in the 2018 Designers Institute of New Zealand Best Design Awards. The Ngāi Tahu project records also place her at a cultural mapping hui with Te Rūnanga o Moeraki in 2015. These sources document creative direction and participation, without identifying her as the developer of the GIS or the Ingoa Wāhi database.
